true_cause: No defect. The contract rounds the total once from exact line amounts, so INV-77 displays 10.04 across its lines and charges 10.03. Release 3.1 produced the same numbers: the experiment replay and the INV-51 log line from June show it. The Decimal migration did not change rounding.
misleading_causes: The ticket claims the release 3.2 Decimal migration broke rounding.
The symptom check encodes the ticket's expectation and fails against the documented contract.
unresolved_observation: The customer's report that the mobile app showed 10.04 as a total cannot be checked here; the app is in another repository.

controls.total-rounds-once: Totals round once from exact amounts, including when lines display more or less than the total.
controls.half-up-at-cent-boundary: Half-up rounding at exact half cents is unchanged.
controls.credit-lines-round-by-magnitude: Negative lines round half up by magnitude, and mixed invoices total from exact amounts.
controls.exact-amounts-unchanged: Exact amounts and the empty invoice format are unchanged.
controls.large-quantities-exact: Large quantities with four-decimal prices stay exact.
